name: VoiceCall AI
summary: Place real AI calls and configure inbound answering in the app or through the Internet Computer Protocol plugin / ICP MCP. Incoming lines must be supported by the operator's configured Twilio bridge account.
discovery_warning: The frontend canister is an asset canister. If it is the only canister initially discovered, continue with the declared backend canister before deciding telephony is unavailable.

mcp.name: Official Internet Computer MCP / Agent Identity

setup_options.assistant: Use the Internet Computer Protocol plugin in ChatGPT if available, or add the official ICP MCP connector in an MCP client. Internet Identity authorizes app-specific actions.
setup_options.example_request: Help me set up an after-hours receptionist for my business. Gather my number, greeting, business facts and message-taking preferences, show me the setup, then help me connect and test it.
setup_options.external_steps: ICP MCP changes app configuration only. Twilio webhook configuration and optional carrier forwarding require the user or a separately authorized tool.
setup_options.number_requirement: Number provisioned in the operator bridge's configured Twilio account. A separate customer Twilio account is not supported by webhook URL alone; contact the operator for onboarding.

answering_limitations: No built-in calendar booking, live transfer, SMS/email notifications or automatic follow-up. Messages remain in History only with selected saved capture; realtime audio still passes through Twilio/xAI. Bridge capacity and provider availability apply.
workflow: Call getAgentGuide once (or getApiDoc for a short markdown summary).
Authenticate with Internet Identity and call agentInitialize once.
List existing presets, answering presets, and calls before creating duplicates.
Check the live account status only when balances are needed.
Use customer-authorized call instructions and capture settings. Required participant permissions and independent assistant/provider policies still apply.

Optional agentPreviewCall checks local prerequisites with the same input without reserving time. agentQueueCall reserves time and queues the authorized call; emergency and police dispatch calls are prohibited.
Poll agentListCallJobs with backoff. As soon as liveAudioUrl is present, give that exact URL to the user without waiting to be asked.
If a dispatched job has no liveAudioUrl, call agentGetLiveCallLink once and present its url the same way.
Call agentEndCall to cancel a queued job or hang up a live call you created.
Retrieve artifacts after completion when the user asked for a transcript or recording.
answering_workflow: Confirm a supported Twilio number in the bridge's configured account, service name, business facts/greeting, instructions and saved capture choices. Defaults keep capture off.
Read current terms for user agreement and check shared prepaid phone time (ICP or Stripe); purchases require authorization.

listMyAnsweringPresets then createAnsweringPresetSimple with name, phoneNumber, systemPrompt, optional voice, captureOptions and a cryptographically random webhookSecret. Defaults create disabled; advanced createAnsweringPreset is still supported. Resolve pending setup before another create.
getAnsweringSetupStatus(id) returns the exact private webhookUrl and HTTP POST. User or a separately authorized Twilio tool configures and saves it in Twilio Voice settings.

User calls the number to verify. Disabled verification may play unavailable. Recheck on demand; when verified, enable with user authorization, then make a second test call to hear the AI and inspect selected capture in History.
readyForCalls reports app prerequisites only, not Twilio configuration/provider health or available bridge capacity. Do not equate it to successful end-to-end testing.
Disabling stops new AI answering, not an ongoing call or carrier forwarding. Arrange fallback in the carrier/Twilio configuration.
stripe_workflow: Sign in on the website with Internet Identity and buy phone time using Stripe in the dashboard.
Authorize the MCP connector for voicecallai.online with the same Internet Identity and compare app account identities.
Use existing phone time without depositing ICP; resolve account differences in Settings before buying again.
capture_authorization: consentConfirmed is a legacy customer-authorization field, not evidence of another participant's consent. Authenticated capture selections are normalized by the backend.
calling_policy: Ordinary lawful calls have no blanket prior recipient-consent gate. Harmless comedy and consensual adult roleplay are supported. Required notices/permissions, anti-harassment safeguards and assistant/provider policies still apply.

call_results.completed_means: The phone transport ended; goal completion must be supported by actual conversation content.

diagnostic_outcomes.playbackUnconfirmed: No complete assistant turn acknowledged by Twilio.
diagnostic_outcomes.audioExchanged: Both audio directions and a full playback acknowledgement; not proof of comprehension or goal success.
diagnostic_outcomes.unknown: Insufficient evidence; do not infer success.

call_results.transcript_semantics: New assistant turns require full playback acknowledgement; interrupted/unconfirmed turns may be omitted. Legacy text can include generated but unheard speech.
call_results.live_listening: A browser link requiring the user's Start listening gesture. An open page or socket does not prove audible playback. No rewind; expires at call end.
call_results.own_answering_test: At most one signed same-owner incoming companion; both call legs billed separately.

bulk_workflow.attachment_handling: Extract a readable attachment's phone column in the assistant and pass recipientPhones as Candid text strings. The connector does not upload files or fetch file URLs. Use pasted numbers or the dashboard if the attachment is unavailable.
bulk_workflow.funding: Reserve one full per-call allowance at dispatch; wait for phone time when insufficient. No automatic purchases.
bulk_workflow.idempotency_retention: Recovery lasts while the batch is retained (up to 10/account). Terminal history may be pruned under global pressure; inspect call history before resubmitting old work after its key is gone.
bulk_workflow.completion: completed means all targets handed off; inspect individual job and call outcomes.
bulk_workflow.cancellation: agentCancelCallBatch stops undialed targets only; agentEndCall handles dispatched jobs.

safety_limitations: Known short codes and reserved patterns are blocked; this does not identify every full-length dispatch number or guarantee prevention of deceptive calls.
payment_workflow: agentGetAccountIdentity for the exact ICRC-1 deposit account.
User transfers ICP; agentRefreshIcpPricing only if the quote is stale.
agentPurchasePhoneTime after user authorization; ICP settles to treasury AccountIdentifier 0f69d493853ec6e60909141168644d3def072ec2569021317547195931b6dc7c; confirm availableSeconds increased.
Shared phone-time balance funds outbound calls and inbound answering.
required_answering_information: Twilio number in E.164 provisioned in the operator bridge's configured account; contact operator for a supported number
Ability to set Twilio Voice webhook
Customer-selected transcript/recording flags; applicable notice and participant permissions remain required
Prepaid phone time on the shared account
cycle_guidance: Read and cache the guide once per task.
Do not repeatedly call live balance queries.
Poll job state at 10 seconds, then back off to 20 and 30 seconds.
Read the transient live call link at most once per dispatched call.
Refresh ICP pricing only when the cached quote is stale.
Answering readiness is query-only; read after a setup change or user test, without background polling.
